scope: Modeling assistant and DSH independent-reviewer requests with reported usage; A includes its separately persisted reviewer. No prechecks, title-generation requests or later Codex visual audits. B original comes from the pre-resume backup; the continuation is added exactly once.
semantics: In the installed DeepSeek Messages adapter, totalTokens = inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens. Cached context is counted again each time it is processed; this is not newly generated text.
completeness: A has three retry attempts without usage, so A reported totals are lower bounds. B original is interrupted with one unclosed tool step; persisted usage includes its already-returned assistant request. Observed usage is not an independently reconciled provider bill.
comparability: A performs independent review; C reports self-check only. Single runs and different QA/render paths prevent attributing token differences solely to the bridge.
